verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's feature-status docs say materialized views (incremental, insert-triggered transformations) and refreshable materialized views (scheduled re-computation) are supported. The ingestion docs say the Kafka table engine and materialized views 'work as documented', which enables continuous stream-to-table transformation inside the platform, and CHKit claims to deploy pipelines as code. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of MV/refreshable-MV behavior on the separated storage layer, details on what CHKit 'pipelines' actually are, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
